source: Derived from Gemini VQA / bbox labels across vpa-pipeline runs maaksons-001..005 (pair_vqa + site reports)
purpose: Object vocabulary for VLM detection on 360° equirectangular site frames. Each entry has one short label and a VLM-readable visual description.
usage_notes: Descriptions emphasize color, shape, placement, and typical co-occurrence so Gemini can locate the object in a full 360 image.
Prefer these canonical labels over free-form synonyms when prompting or parsing detections.
Objects are things expected on this outdoor building-construction site (steel frame, foundations, plant, perimeter wall, site compound).
counting_mode: instance_track | stock_unit | presence | vlm_estimate — controls which agent count tool to use.
retrieval_hard: true means SigLIP top-K may be unreliable; tools should degrade or fall back to trajectory stations.
retrieval_query (optional): short phrase for SigLIP only. If omitted, label with underscores to spaces is used. Long description is for detection prompts, not retrieval.

objects.label: mobile_crane
objects.description: Large yellow or red rough-terrain mobile crane with a long telescopic boom, often with outriggers down, standing in the open work area for steel lifts.

objects.label: skid_steer_loader
objects.description: Compact Bobcat-style skid-steer loader (often red, white, or yellow) with a front bucket, sitting or working on dirt or paved ground in the central clearing.

objects.label: water_truck
objects.description: Blue-and-white or similar water tanker truck parked on site, usually mid-ground near the open yard or perimeter.

objects.label: utility_truck
objects.description: Small white light utility truck or pickup parked along the site edge or near the office compound.

objects.label: wheelbarrow
objects.description: Single-wheel construction wheelbarrow on or near a concrete slab, often with buckets or scrap nearby.

objects.label: steel_column
objects.description: Vertical red-oxide or brown structural steel H-column standing upright on a foundation or slab, part of the building frame.

objects.label: steel_beam
objects.description: Horizontal structural steel I-beam or girder, either already spanning between columns or lying as a long red-primed member on the ground.

objects.label: curved_steel_rafter
objects.description: Curved or arched red-primed steel roof rafter connecting columns, forming part of the overhead building envelope.

objects.label: steel_frame_structure
objects.description: Assembled skeleton of vertical columns plus beams or curved rafters forming a partial building frame over a slab or plinth.

objects.label: staged_steel_beams
objects.description: Stockpile or loose bundles of red-primed structural steel beams and columns lying on the dirt or slab waiting for erection.

objects.label: rebar_bundle
objects.description: Tied bundle of long straight steel reinforcement bars lying on the ground, often along a perimeter wall or trench edge.

objects.label: rebar_cage
objects.description: Tied circular or rectangular rebar cage sitting in an excavated footing pit or trench before concrete is poured.

objects.label: rebar_mesh
objects.description: Flat steel reinforcement mesh or mat laid across an excavated trench or foundation area.

objects.label: exposed_foundation_rebar
objects.description: Open foundation trench or footing pit with visible tied rebar cages or mats still exposed before slab pour.

objects.label: concrete_slab
objects.description: Large poured and finished concrete floor slab covering former dirt, rebar, or excavation, often light grey and relatively flat.

objects.label: concrete_foundation_plinth
objects.description: Raised concrete plinth, footing, or low foundation wall where steel columns sit after site clearing.

objects.label: concrete_stairs
objects.description: Short flight of poured concrete steps giving access between ground level and an elevated slab or structure.

objects.label: precast_concrete_section
objects.description: Large precast concrete block, L-shaped wall panel, or heavy concrete segment staged on the ground for later use.

objects.label: demolition_rubble
objects.description: Irregular pile of broken concrete, bricks, and debris from excavation or demolition in the central work area.

objects.label: aggregate_stockpile
objects.description: Heap of sand, gravel, or fine aggregate stockpiled near plant or steel staging for concrete or backfill work.

objects.label: excavated_ground
objects.description: Open dirt excavation, trench, or uneven graded earth where foundations or utilities are being prepared.

objects.label: perimeter_concrete_wall
objects.description: Tall precast concrete perimeter wall panels enclosing the site, typically forming a continuous boundary behind the work area.

objects.label: razor_wire
objects.description: Coils of barbed or razor wire mounted along the top of the concrete perimeter wall for site security.

objects.label: site_hoarding
objects.description: Temporary construction hoarding or fence panel, often near the site office or gate, separate from the main concrete wall.

objects.label: site_office_container
objects.description: Blue, white, or branded modular site cabin/container used as an office, often marked or labeled and parked on the perimeter.

objects.label: site_office_compound
objects.description: Cluster of modular office cabins and storage containers forming a temporary site compound in the background.

objects.label: utility_shed
objects.description: Small additional container or shed unit, sometimes with green mesh screening, used for tools or storage.

objects.label: water_tank
objects.description: Cylindrical water storage tank near the site compound or utility area.

objects.label: scaffolding
objects.description: Yellow mobile scaffolding tower or scaffold frames standing beside the steel structure for access during assembly.

objects.label: corrugated_cladding_stack
objects.description: Tall neat stacks of grey corrugated metal roofing or cladding sheets staged on the ground for later installation.

objects.label: staged_panels
objects.description: Stacks of flat grey cladding, roofing, or wall panels delivered and parked near a steel frame awaiting install.

objects.label: paver_stack
objects.description: Stacked stone pavers, tiles, or paving slabs arranged in piles for courtyard or walkway finishing.

objects.label: brick_paving
objects.description: Installed interlocking brick or block paved walkway covering former dirt paths through the central site.

objects.label: pvc_pipe_bundle
objects.description: Bundle or small stack of white PVC pipes or electrical conduits lying on the ground in the staging area.

objects.label: bagged_materials
objects.description: Stack of bagged cement, grout, or similar construction materials near the site office or slab edge.

objects.label: hazard_tape
objects.description: Red-and-white striped safety hazard tape laid on the ground or marking an exclusion zone.

objects.label: site_signage
objects.description: Yellow or other high-visibility construction information, diversion, or safety sign standing on the site.

objects.label: communications_tower
objects.description: Tall lattice communications or cell tower visible beyond or beside the site boundary in the background.

objects.label: standing_water
objects.description: Puddles or sheet of standing water on a concrete slab or low ground creating a reflective wet surface.

objects.label: cut_vegetation_pile
objects.description: Pile of cut branches, cleared shrubs, or removed tree debris near a wall corner or cleared yard.

objects.label: mature_tree
objects.description: Standing mature tree or large shrub inside or beside the work area that may be retained or later removed.

objects.label: metal_plates
objects.description: Flat steel plates or scrap metal pieces staged on a newly poured slab near active steelwork.

objects.label: buckets_and_hand_tools
objects.description: Construction buckets, small hand tools, or scrap steel pieces clustered on a slab near active work.
